verdict.rationale: Gazebo is open-source and its native simulation data (SDF worlds, model descriptions) is stored in open XML/text formats that users can freely copy, modify, and reuse outside the tool, as shown by docs on example worlds and SDF snippet copying. However, there is no explicit documentation framing this as a 'data export' or migration/exit path, nor any discussion of account/data portability since Gazebo is a local/self-hosted tool without a proprietary data store to escape. Missing for 10: explicit export tooling or documentation, discussion of data portability/migration, and independent confirmation that all simulation artifacts (not just SDF files) are open-format.
